mapper.select: SELECT v.visit_id AS visitId, p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.add1, NULLIF(p.add2, '')) AS address, NULLIF(p.first_image, '') AS imageUrl, v.created_at AS visitedAt FROM visit v JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.visit_id DESC

SELECT s.stamp_id AS stampId, s.stamp_name AS stampName, s.description AS description, s.requirement AS requirement, p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, (ms.member_stamp_id IS NOT NULL) AS isAcquired, ms.created_at AS acquiredAt FROM stamp s JOIN place p ON p.place_id = s.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN member_stamp ms ON ms.stamp_id = s.stamp_id AND ms.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE s.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY s.stamp_id

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, COUNT(cp.course_place_id) AS placeCnt, COUNT(v.place_id) AS visitedCnt, ROUND(COUNT(v.place_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(cp.course_place_id), 2) AS progressRate, COUNT(v.place_id) = COUNT(cp.course_place_id) AS isCompleted FROM course c JOIN course_place cp ON cp.course_id = c.course_id JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT place_id FROM visit WHERE member_id = #{memberId}) v ON v.place_id = cp.place_id WHERE c.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY c.course_id, c.name ORDER BY isCompleted ASC, progressRate DESC, c.course_id ASC
